# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v3 c8 P18](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0018), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy is a big, fat, stolid youth with a round, freckled, expressionless face. He is frequently seen grinning or beaming.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_

## Personality

He is extremely shy, quiet, and suffers from a notable lack of conversational skills. Despite his silence, he is a hard-working, good-natured youth with no bad habits.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)_

## Traits

- Shy  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>
- Stolid  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Good-natured  <sub>[v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006)</sub>
- Hard-working  <sub>[v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Goals

- To marry and settle down on his farm  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022)</sub>

## History

Around the age of twenty, Billy drove Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and his sister Jane Andrews to a concert at the White Sands Hotel, secretly admiring Anne despite his inability to talk much with her. After his father gave him the upper farm in his own name, he decided to marry, but his extreme shyness prevented him from proposing to Anne directly. He begged his sister Jane to ask Anne on his behalf; when Anne refused, he quickly moved on without a broken heart and married Nettie Blewett instead. They 'appeared out' at church together following their wedding, beaming with pride.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
